git add internal/doctor/sandbox.go internal/doctor/sandbox_test.go && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(doctor): #9/#2 — argv-boundary-preserving, nonce-authenticated invocation log

Two related defects in hookInvocationObserved's stub log (qodo, PR
#515):

- The stub serialized argv with shell "$*", and the verifier compared
  that lossy space-joined string via strings.Join(argv, " "). A hook
  calling `ethos 'audit seal'` (one argument) and one calling
  `ethos audit seal` (two arguments) collapsed to the identical
  logged string "audit seal", so the single-argument call falsely
  satisfied a search for the two-argument pair.
- The log file lived at a predictable path ("invocations.log" in the
  hook's own working directory) with no authentication, so a hook
  that never calls ethos at all could satisfy the check merely by
  writing matching text directly (qodo's PoC:
  `printf 'audit seal\n' > invocations.log`).

Fixed together: the stub now writes each argument on its own line (a
`for` loop over "$@", not "$*") behind a fresh per-run nonce, so the
verifier compares argv element-by-element and a static forged line
lacking the nonce no longer matches. This closes the argv-ambiguity
bug outright and defeats the reviewer's example PoC; it does not
defend against a hook that reads the stub script at runtime to learn
the nonce — that residual is the same no-full-OS-sandbox limitation
DES-077 already documents for arbitrary code execution generally
(see DESIGN.md addendum).

Both regressions confirmed failing against pre-fix code before the
fix landed. Full TestHookInvocationObserved* suite (including the M2
prefix-match and process-group-cleanup fixtures) still green.
EOF
)"
